classification: 本轮工程与约定样例客观验收，非整体产品或公开上线
target: 现有前端+后端聊天组合

issues.problem: 记忆首次加载未完成即可写入，可能被旧读取覆盖
issues.test: blocks writes until the first memory read completes

issues.problem: 记忆写入成功后读取失败，界面无法区分是否已保存
issues.test: a successful write with failed readback is not presented as a failed write

issues.problem: 网络异常结果不确定时可直接重复保存
issues.test: an uncertain write retains draft and only retries the read

issues.problem: 关闭记忆弹窗后焦点落回body
issues.test: returns keyboard focus to the opener after the dialog is removed

issues.problem: 明确不想听建议时仍建议先慢慢喘口气

limits: 小样本客观验收；不评价统计稳定性
